title: Panopticon (Control fan game) — inspect, test and classify anomalous objects in a short 3D browser game
author: supertweedo
selftext:
Game Title: Panopticon

Playable Link: [https://supertweedo.itch.io/panopticon](https://supertweedo.itch.io/panopticon)

Platform: Web browser (desktop, mouse required)

Description: You're the agent on duty at an intake airlock for a secret bureau that contains paranormal objects. Each object rises onto your bench: turn it over in 3D, sweep it with a resonance probe, check it under UV light. If that's not enough, send it into the test chamber (light, darkness, sound, a remote arm, or a technician walking in), but every test costs time and strains containment for the whole shift. Then classify it: Ordinary, Altered or Object of Power. Let something anomalous out and it's a containment breach.

**It's a short prototype**: one shift, about 10 to 15 minutes. I'm mostly looking for feedback on clarity (did you understand what to do?), the examine/test balance, and whether you'd want more days. There's a "Send feedback" link in the game, or just comment here.

Unofficial, non-commercial fan game inspired by Control (Remedy). Not affiliated with Remedy.

Free to Play Status:

\[x\] Free to play

\[ \] Demo/Paid

Involvement: Solo project. I designed it and built it with AI-assisted development.
